problems.prices_changed: Bill banate samay daam badal gaye. Naye daam chinhit hain. Kul jaanchein, phir dobara payment lein.
problems.stock_short: {{name}}: itni matra bechne ke liye stock kaafi nahin hai. Matra ghatayein ya line hatayein.
problems.items_unavailable_one: Line {{lines}} ab bechi nahin ja sakti (archive hai, ya GST dar nahin hai). Use hatakar phir save karein.
problems.items_unavailable_other: Lines {{lines}} ab bechi nahin ja sakti (archive hain, ya GST dar nahin hai). Unhein hatakar phir save karein.
problems.approval_required: Yeh chhoot is login ki seema se zyada hai. Ise hatayein, ya malik se manzoor karwayein.
problems.approval_invalid: Malik ki manzoori ki avadhi khatam ho gayi ya woh pehle hi istemal ho chuki hai. Malik se phir poochein.
problems.gstin_required: Is branch ka GSTIN abhi nahin hai. Bill save karne se pehle Settings mein Business ke neeche jodein.
problems.buyer_details_required: Bina GSTIN wale grahak ko GST se pehle ₹50,000 ya usse zyada ke bill par grahak ka naam, pata aur rajya chahiye. Unhein grahak mein jodein (F3).
problems.customer_unavailable: Yeh grahak archive ho gaya hai. Doosra grahak chunein, ya ise bill se hatayein (F3).
problems.wholesale_off: Settings mein thok daam band hain. Bill ko retail par karein (F8).
problems.place_of_supply: Vyapari grahak ka bill unke rajya mein ya counter par diya jaata hai. Bhejne ki jagah badlein (F3).
problems.held_bill_invalid: Jis roke gaye bill se yeh aaya tha woh ab maanya nahin hai. Uske bina aage badhne ke liye phir save karein.
problems.invalid_quantity: Is bill ki ek matra uski ikai se mel nahin khaati, jaise aadha piece. Matra theek karein.
problems.payments_mismatch: Payment kul se mel nahin khaate. Dobara payment lein (F10).
problems.key_reused: Yeh bill pehle hi alag saman ke saath save ho chuka hai, shayad connection tootne se pehle. Naya bill shuru karein (Alt+N) aur malik se jaanchwayein.
problems.udhaar_needs_customer: Udhaar ke liye customer chahiye. Customer ka naam aur phone jodein (F3), ya bill se udhaar hatayein (F10).
problems.udhaar_needs_phone: Udhaar ke liye customer ka phone number chahiye. Use customer mein jodein (F3).
problems.udhaar_not_allowed: Yeh login udhaar nahin de sakta. Malik se ise chalu karwayein, ya bill se udhaar hatayein (F10).
problems.over_credit_limit: Yeh udhaar customer ki credit seema se upar hai. Malik se manzoor karwayein, ya kam udhaar lein (F10).
problems.advance_changed: Chunne ke baad customer ka advance badal gaya hai. Phir se payment lein (F10).
problems.network: Connection nahin hai. Ho sakta hai bill save ho chuka ho. Jaanchne ke liye Enter dabayein: bill do baar save nahin hoga. Tab tak bill badla nahin ja sakta.
problems.failed: Bill save nahin ho saka. Phir koshish karein; baar-baar ho to connection jaanchein.

person.overtimeHint: Overtime nahi milta to khaali chhodein.
person.salaryHint: Baad mein bhi tay kar sakte hain. Tab tak "Salary tay nahi" dikhega.

access.title: Anumatiyaan
access.lead: Chunein ki yeh vyakti kya kar sakta hai. Jo band rakhenge, woh yeh nahi khol payenge.
access.limitHint: 0 se 100 tak, do dashmlav tak. Isse upar ki chhoot ke liye aapka password chahiye.
access.noMoney: Staff ko salary ya munaafa tab tak nahi dikhta, jab tak aap use chalu na karein.
access.confirmBody: Koi kya kar sakta hai, yeh badalne ke liye aapka password chahiye.

sell.label: Grahakon ka bill banana
sell.hint: Billing screen chalana, bill hold karna aur phir kholna.

discount.label: Chhoot dena
discount.hint: Neeche ki seema tak. Usse upar bill ke liye aapka password chahiye.

udhaar.label: Udhaar dena
udhaar.hint: Naam aur phone wale customer ko udhaar bechein. Credit seema se upar bill ke liye aapka password chahiye.

manage.label: Grahak jodna aur badalna
manage.hint: Billing ke samay naya grahak jodna.

view.label: Saamaan dekhna
view.hint: Saamaan aur daam dekhna, kharid ka daam kabhi nahi.

manage.label: Saamaan jodna aur badalna
manage.hint: Saamaan, categories aur units jodna, badalna aur archive karna.

view_cost.label: Kharid ka daam dekhna
view_cost.hint: Aapne jis daam par kharida, aur margin.

view.label: Stock dekhna
view.hint: Kitna stock hai aur uska itihaas.

adjust.label: Stock badalna
adjust.hint: Shuruaati stock daalna aur ginti sudhaarna.

mark.label: Haaziri lagaana
mark.hint: Apni shaakha ka roz ka register bharna.

view_all.label: Sabki haaziri dekhna
view_all.hint: Doosron ke din aur mahine. Apni haaziri ve hamesha dekhte hain.

new.confirmBody: Naya login turant istemaal ho sakta hai, isliye jodne ke liye aapka password chahiye.

reset.title: {{name}} ka password reset karein
reset.body: Naya password chunkar unhein bata dein. Woh har computer se turant logout ho jaayenge aur 'Mera password' mein khud ise badal sakte hain.
reset.done: {{name}} ka naya password lag gaya. Woh har jagah se logout ho gaye.

deactivate.title: {{name}} ko band karein?
deactivate.undo: Aap jab chahein login phir chalu kar sakte hain.

reactivate.title: {{name}} ko phir chalu karein?
reactivate.body: Woh usi password aur unhi anumatiyon se phir login kar payenge. Iske liye aapka password chahiye.

notFound.title: Aisa koi staff login nahi
notFound.body: Shayad galat likha gaya. Ise staff ki list se kholein.

errors.invalid_permissions: Yeh switch aapas mein mel nahi khaate. Page phir se kholkar koshish karein.
errors.not_found: Yeh login ab nahi hai. List par wapas jaayein.
errors.marks_before_joining: Is joining tareekh se pehle ki hazri lagi hui hai. Pehle ki tareekh chunein.
errors.stale: Kisi aur ne is vyakti ko badal diya hai. Page dobara kholkar phir koshish karein.

salaryCard.title: Salary
salaryCard.lead: Badlaav kisi mahine ki 1 tareekh se shuru hota hai. Purane rate record mein rehte hain, isliye purani parchiyan sahi rehti hain.
salaryCard.loadFailed: Salary ka itihaas load nahi ho saka.

login.title: Login
login.lead: {{name}} ka login nahi hai. Hazri aur salary bina login ke bhi chalti hain; login dein to woh sign in kar sakenge.
login.body: Woh inse turant login kar sakenge. Kya kar sakte hain, yeh baad mein chunein.
login.done: {{name}} ab {{username}} naam se login kar sakte hain. Neeche chunein ki woh kya kar sakte hain.

branches.title: Branch
branches.lead: Is business ki har dukaan, apne counter, stock aur staff ke saath. Branch kabhi mitai nahi jaati: use archive karein, uski history bani rehti hai.
branches.single: Is business ki ek hi dukaan hai. Doosri dukaan kholein to branch jodein; tab tak kuch aur nahi badalta.

form.name: Branch ka naam
form.codeHint: 4 tak bade akshar ya ank. Yeh bill number mein jaata hai, jaise AND (AND/26-27/42).
form.codeInvalid: 1 se 4 bade akshar ya ank likhein
form.codeTaken: Yeh code kisi aur branch mein hai
form.codePrefix: Yeh code aapka bill prefix hai. Doosra code rakhein, ya Settings mein prefix badlein.
form.gstinHint: Doosre rajya ki branch ka apna GSTIN chahiye.

archive.title: {{name}} archive karein?
archive.body: Iske computer bhula diye jaate hain aur wahan logged in har vyakti logout ho jaata hai. Iska stock aur history bani rehti hai, aur aap ise baad mein wapas la sakte hain.
archive.inUse_one: {{count}} staff login ki yeh home branch hai. Pehle use doosri branch mein bhejein.
archive.inUse_other: {{count}} staff login ki yeh home branch hai. Pehle unhein doosri branch mein bhejein.
archive.headOffice: Head office archive nahi ho sakta.

access.title: Yahan bhi kaam kar sakte hain
access.lead: Home branch ke alawa woh branch, jahan yeh vyakti login kar sakta hai. Woh sirf usi branch ko dekhta hai jismein logged in hai.
access.confirmTitle: {{name}} kahan kaam kar sakte hain, yeh badlein
access.confirmBody: Isse tay hota hai ki yeh login kin counters par chalega, isliye aapka password chahiye.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.loadFailed: Alerts load nahi ho sake. Connection jaanchein.
alerts.empty: Abhi kisi par dhyaan dene ki zaroorat nahi hai.
alerts.truncated: Sabse naye {{shown}} dikhaye ja rahe hain.

typeHints.out_of_stock: Kisi branch mein koi saamaan khatam ho gaya hai.
typeHints.low_stock: Koi saamaan apne kam-stock level par ya usse neeche hai.

attendance.lead: Sab pehle se maujood maane jaate hain. Din badalne ke liye tap karein.
attendance.pickBranch: Register dekhne ke liye ek shaakha chunein.
attendance.empty: Is shaakha aur din ke register mein koi nahi hai.
attendance.leavesUsed: Is mahine {{total}} mein se {{used}} paid chhuttiyan li gayeen
attendance.own: Aap apni hazri khud nahi laga sakte

reason.title: Pichhla din kyon badal rahe hain?
reason.lead: {{date}} aaj se pehle ka din hai, isliye yeh badlaav aapke kaaran ke saath log mein jaayega.
reason.label: Kaaran

attendance.changed: {{name}} ko kisi aur ne badal diya hai. Dekhkar phir tap karein.
attendance.failed: Yeh badlaav save nahi ho saka. Connection jaanchkar phir koshish karein.

errors.future_date: Hazri aaj aur pichhle dinon ki hi lag sakti hai, aage ki nahi.
errors.not_on_register: Woh vyakti is din kaam par nahi tha.
errors.other_branch: Woh vyakti kisi aur shaakha ka hai.
errors.own_attendance: Aap apni hazri khud nahi laga sakte.

month.onlyOwn: Yahan sirf aapke apne din dikhte hain.
month.lead: Ek vyakti ke din, mahine ke hisaab se. Aage ke din khaali rehte hain.
month.empty: Dikhane ke liye abhi koi staff nahi hai.
month.holidaysTakenHint: Gair-haazir aur chhutti ke din. Saptahik chhutti aur dukaan ki chhuttiyan ginti mein nahi aatin.

holidays.title: Dukaan ki chhuttiyan
holidays.lead: Jin dinon dukaan band rehti hai. Sab chhutti par dikhte hain, isliye kisi ko mark nahi karna padta.
holidays.empty: {{year}} mein abhi koi chhutti nahi hai.
holidays.loadFailed: Chhuttiyan load nahi ho sakeen. Connection jaanchkar phir koshish karein.
holidays.name: Naam
holidays.removeBody: Yeh abhi se ginti mein nahi aayegi. Record mein rahegi, aur log mein darj rahega ki kisne hatayi.
